name: edit-file
description: Replace exact text in an existing file (find-and-replace) in one call. Returns a unified diff so you can verify the change without re-reading. If old_string is not found, the error includes a content preview — read the file first and copy the exact text (whitespace and line endings must match). Use this instead of sed/perl one-liners for targeted edits.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (absolute or relative). Must exist.

old_string.description: The exact text to replace. Must match the file byte-for-byte, including whitespace and line endings. Read the file first to get it right.

new_string.description: The replacement text. Empty string deletes the matched text.
